decisions.reason: The book title and discipline passages support statistika; the edition keeps statistik for a computed statistic or idiomatic adjective.
The witness uses rata-rata 72 times and explicitly pairs it with mean.
Rata-rata remains the controlled term. Rerata is retained only where the source explicitly introduces a synonym, not as a competing default.
The 237-page field witness consistently uses interval kelas; it is also the clearer Indonesian head order for a histogram class interval.
The witness uses simpangan baku 24 times.
The witness's data kualitatif is broader and is not a mathematically exact replacement for categorical data.
The witness uses independen for events; saling explicitly expresses the symmetric relation between variables.
Model independen could mean a model independent of something else; model independensi denotes a model encoding independence.

The source paragraph names a branch of statistics. The witness uses statistika inferensi/inferensia; the conventional adjectival field name statistika inferensial is clearer and avoids the awkward noun-noun calque.
Directly confirmed in the field witness.
Directly confirmed in the field witness; its occasional hipotesis tandingan is treated as a synonym, not the edition default.
The witness repeatedly pairs probabilitas with peluang. The edition will prefer peluang for an individual event and retain probabilitas in established field or chapter names.

replace_in_translated_material: kelas interval -> interval kelas, with natural plural and modifier order
do_not_replace: raw variable names or code tokens
